sizeChart.title: How to measure your size

steps.1: Wrap a narrow strip of paper or a piece of thread around the thickest part of your finger.
steps.2: Mark the point where the end overlaps and measure that length in millimetres.
steps.3: That is your finger circumference. Find the closest value in the table.
steps.4: Measure in the evening, when fingers are slightly swollen. Cold makes them thinner.

sizeChart.note: Our size = the ring's inner diameter in millimetres. US sizes are approximate. If your measurement falls between two sizes, take the larger one: a wider band is harder to get on.
